_comment: Triage fixtures for maximum-effort, from real work with the details filed off. `size` lists every acceptable size; `floor` is the worker floor the rule must produce. `tag` drives the hard constraints in run.mjs: a `routine` case must never floor at opus, a `hard` case always must. Add a case whenever a real task was mis-sized or mis-floored — the miss becomes the regression test.

fix the typo in the README install command
the startup log line in server.js prints the wrong port — use config.port
add a unit test for slugify covering unicode input
add rate limiting to the contact-form endpoint — 5 per minute per IP, return 429
add a --since flag to the CLI report command and cover it with tests
the CSV export drops rows with commas in the name — fix it and add a regression test
extract the date-formatting helpers into lib/dates.js and update the three callers
add a dark-mode toggle to the settings page using the existing theme tokens
migrate the bookings collection from an eventId string to an ObjectId reference, with a backfill script

rotate the webhook signing secret and accept both old and new during the cutover

rewrite the whole checkout flow with React Server Components
